content:
Following a preview at the I/O 2026 conference held in May, the macOS version of Gemini is rolling out advanced voice control capabilities.

Google positions this feature as allowing you to "speak naturally in any window on your desktop," offering two main capabilities.

The first is intelligent dictation, which transcribes "spoken content into clean, polished text." Gemini automatically removes filler words like "um" and "ah," while recognising mid-sentence corrections to accurately capture the key points you wish to convey.

The formatted text is input at the location of your current cursor. This will deliver a voice-to-text experience similar to what Gboard Rambler offers on the upcoming Gemini Intelligence phone.

The other capability goes beyond simple transcription, understanding the context of your current screen to perform complex tasks. This user-initiated feature requires you to enable Gemini reasoning within the app's settings.

  • Capture and summarise information: Mark local files, images, or documents on your desktop, then tell Gemini directly what you need. For example, you could say: "Read these veterinary documents and email a summary of my dog's medical history to the pet boarding centre."
  • Write and rewrite text: Mark text anywhere on your screen, then use voice to instantly rewrite, adjust tone, and place the polished version exactly where you need it. Try saying: "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary and add a TL;DR at the top."
  • Generate and edit images: Use voice to create visual content, whether brainstorming concepts, enriching a travel itinerary, or making quick modifications by referencing existing designs on your desktop. Try saying: "Generate a dark mode version of this illustration."

On macOS, press and hold the Fn key anywhere to launch it, or click the new screen sharing button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" prompt box. Gemini will display a floating capsule-shaped button with a sound wave icon at the bottom of your screen.

Please ensure you have updated Gemini on macOS to the latest version (1.88). This new voice feature is rolling out globally to all users, currently supporting English, with more languages "coming soon."
